svg.text: A 27-LETTER KEY CHECKED BY HAND: THE FORCED LETTERS ON ONE LINE, THE CANDIDATE UNDER IT
Write the forced letters once; under them
write each candidate key and tick or cross the
24 checked slots. A single cross ends the

The best any key did was more than three
